Spice Affair Catering — Multi-Cuisine Wedding Catering, Bengaluru

Spice Affair is a Bengaluru caterer offering a wide multi-cuisine range — South
Indian, North Indian, Continental, and Pan-Asian live stations — popular for
cosmopolitan weddings with diverse guest lists.

Their standard multi-cuisine package is ₹1,300 per plate, with premium global
menus at ₹1,750 per plate. Live counters and dessert stations are bundled in the
premium tier.

Contact: +91 80889 65120 · hello@spiceaffair.example
Location: Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (198 reviews)
